about: C7 People, Photos, Downloads, Store (SM §4.1, §4.2; PLAN §1.7 default profile). Every rule is behind wp.c7. Pops: the attended media tile (+15 mm, content card >= 150 px, rule 2 admits +15 for a 405 x 228 tile; the More circle riding it may lower it to +10) and the Now Downloading card's 60 px Pause / Resume circle (+10 mm: s = 60 >= 52). Nothing else in the area pops: friend rows, conversation, compose, Downloads rows, the account page and the viewer / clip player stay at 0 (crop budget 0 over media, SM-D12); menus, alerts and sheets are C1c's modal rules. The /invites card is not a rule: 70-social.js tags it as one panel plate (data-lgs-plate, id c7-invites) while the route is windowless.
